data_ticker_mausam.rootCause: TEST problem, not a site problem. /mausam shows weather ONLY for a place the visitor has set (Batch 7L-1, src/screens/Mausam.jsx line 84: `!location ? null : ...`; LocationControl.jsx: 'never a silent default place'). Without a place the page shows the 'share my location' card and no temperature. In the failing run the browser had no location: both screenshots of that run show no place - data-staging-gates-home.png shows the home weather card 'मौसम देखने के लिए अपनी जगह बताएँ' and data-staging-gates-mausam.png shows the share-location card still on screen. The script was edited at 04:09:16 IST by the previous session (file mtime; the file was untracked, so the earlier text is not preserved) to give the browser context geolocation permission + a fixed Sagar position, and the 04:09:39 re-run (results-staging-data.json) passed with 21°. Reproduced independently on 2026-10-15: with geolocation granted, LocationProvider names the place on load and staging /mausam shows 21° within 2 s; weather_cache_v2 GET 200 from the staging Supabase project; no console error other than the known B17 localhost modulepreload CSP noise and the Cloudflare beacon CSP block.

data_ticker_mausam.alsoAdded: read-only mode (automatic for kissansahyog.com / www / kissansahyog-prod.pages.dev, or --read-only): every browser context aborts non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests (e.g. /mausam's weather_grid_requests upsert and the recent_crop_reports RPC POST) and the 'post' gate is refused, so prod gates write nothing to the prod database.
data_ticker_mausam.why: The assertion 'a temperature is shown' is correct for a visitor who has a place; the test must create that precondition the same way a real visitor does (granted location) instead of failing on the documented 'no place -> no weather' behaviour.
